# Kotaku

> > Gaming news, culture, and commentary covering console, handheld, PC, and mobile gaming with a focus on industry developments and pop culture crossovers.

Kotaku is a video game journalism website featuring news, previews, reviews, and commentary on gaming culture. The site covers major platforms including PlayStation, Nintendo DS, iPhone, and PC gaming, with contributions from writers like Mike Fahey, Luke Plunkett, Brian Ashcraft, and Michael McWhertor.

## Key Topics

- Console gaming (PlayStation, Xbox)
- Handheld gaming (Nintendo DS, PSP)
- Mobile gaming (iPhone)
- Gaming culture and community
- Game industry news and announcements
- Action figures and collectibles
- Game adaptations (film, media)
- MMO and online gaming
- Indie games and puzzle games
- Japanese gaming market
- Game development studios
- Gaming controversies and social issues
- Retro and classic gaming

- [Asashi Shimbun Report Sexual Predators Now Using "Game Sites"](https://kotaku.com/asashi-shimbun-report-sexual-predators-now-using-game-5140778): Tokyo police report doubled sex crimes via gaming sites in 2008
- [ESRB Denies Working With Iran](https://kotaku.com/esrb-denies-working-with-iran-5119729): ESRB refutes reports of partnership with Iran rating system
- ["Sony Is Doomed!" Ray Redirected Toward PSP](https://kotaku.com/sony-is-doomed-ray-redirected-toward-psp-5120359): PSP market struggles analyzed as media shifts focus from PS3
